name: Piercing Arrows
body:
The heads of your arrows are especially sharp. They are able to pierce through even the toughest hides, exoskeletons, and even the scales of a dragon!

Prerequisite(s): 5th-level Arcane Archer

Benefit: Arrows that you fire ignore three points of damage reduction.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times, which allow the affects to stack. For example if you took this feat three times, arrows that you fire ignore nine points of a target’s damage resistance.
